stops.note: the asymmetrical, often wavy-bladed dagger of Java; much later, in 2005, UNESCO proclaimed the Indonesian kris a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity
the Hikayat Hang Tuah, epic of the Malacca Sultanate's greatest warrior, turns on his magical kris Taming Sari
early English spellings were creese and crease; Joseph Conrad's Malay novels, starting with Almayer's Folly in 1895, later made it a stock prop

current_meaning: a Malay or Indonesian dagger with a wavy blade
